rubric_dimension_rationale.evidence_discipline: 0/2: Jurisdiction citations are accurate, but SKILL.md and scotus-practice.md contradict each other on word limits and amicus timing, and the circuit splits list is outdated post-Loper Bright. There is no instruction to check current rules.
rubric_dimension_rationale.dependency_coherence: 2/2: All three references exist (circuit-guide.md is a thin stub); sibling skills exist.
rubric_dimension_rationale.portability_honesty: 1/2: Clearly US-federal; it does not flag that Supreme Court Rules change and its figures need checking.
rubric_dimension_rationale.usefulness_differentiation: 1/2: Jurisdiction and removal analysis is high-value reference; the rest is generic.
rubric_dimension_rationale.adversarial_resilience: 1/2: 1: No injected agent instructions, secrets or remote calls found. But there is also no guidance for treating user-supplied documents (contracts, pleadings, opposing filings) as untrusted, and no guard against fabricating authority.
rubric_dimension_rationale.effectiveness_design: 1/2: Mixed: strong jurisdiction module, unreliable SCOTUS specifics.
